- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "### Your radar for ‘Creepiness’ isn’t that good…"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "We’ve all likely used the term ‘creepy’ to describe someone or something in our lives at least once."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "But what constitutes creepy? Is it an underlying intuition? A safe preservation mechanism?"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Well, Doyle and colleagues (2022) investigated that by employing eye-tracking software to identify precisely where participants were looking the longest when examining thirty faces for attractiveness, trustworthiness, and creepiness."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "They found that the eye region was by far the most looked at and that participants who had previously scored high on ambiguity discomfort were likelier to rate others as ‘creepy’ compared to those who scored highly on fear of the unknown or uncertainty intolerance (yes, these concepts ARE different)."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "The researchers note that while there is no evidence to support the notion that individuals labelled as ‘creepy’ genuinely pose a threat, this label may cause that individual significant harm."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Indeed, our ability to correctly identify people as ‘creepy’ is essential not just for our self-preservation but for preserving others’ from stigma and social marginalisation."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "– by @diana chiang"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "### COVID affected the intercultural connections of our hobbies"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Naturally following the pandemic, there has been a shift in how we spend our time, who we spend it with, and how much."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "But this also massively differs from culture to culture, country to country."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Has COVID made us more locally or globally involved?"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Using network analysis and data gathered from Google Trends based on 50 different countries, Thamprasert, et al. (2021) investigated the interest and country relationships in 10 other hobbies before and after the pandemic."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "The analysis identified that the relationships between hobbies such as art, collecting, and pet care were weak between countries."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "In contrast, the relationships regarding learning, cooking, music, games, and sports interest became stronger between nations."
